title: XR in Healthcare & Wellbeing
description: Join neuroscientist and digital medicine pioneer Dr. Walter Greenleaf and XR wellness innovator Tristan Elizabeth Gribbin for an in-depth discussion on how immersive technologies are transforming healthcare and well-being. Dr. Greenleaf will explore how AI and XR are enhancing diagnostics, personalizing treatment, and improving clinical training—particularly in areas like PTSD, stroke recovery, and behavioral health. Tristan will share her journey in creating Flow, a VR meditation platform that brings mindfulness practices to new audiences, and discuss how immersive tools can reduce stress and promote mental resilience.
